root_cause.text: The `v9fs_apply_options()` function ORs new mount access mode flags onto the existing `flags` field without clearing the previous access mode bits, causing both the default (`V9FS_ACCESS_CLIENT`) and user-specified (`V9FS_ACCESS_USER`) bits to be set simultaneously, which fails exact-value comparisons and leads to fallback to `INVALID_UID`.

For 9P2000.L, session_init sets V9FS_ACCESS_CLIENT as the default, so when the user mounts with 'access=user', both bits end up set." The patch adds `if (ctx->session_opts.flags & V9FS_ACCESS_MASK) v9ses->flags &= ~V9FS_ACCESS_MASK;` before the OR operation to clear the access mask first.
